messages:
Maya (devex): Heads-up: pip install redwood-inference inside a Windows venv fails with SSL verify error on 3.8/3.11/3.12.
Maya (devex): Command: `python -m venv .venv && .\.venv\Scripts\activate && pip install redwood-inference`
Maya (devex): Error: `ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed`
Alex (sdk): thanks. can you run `python -c "import ssl,certifi;print(ssl.get_default_verify_paths(), certifi.where())"` and paste output?
Maya (devex): it prints DefaultVerifyPaths with cafile=None and certifi path present.
Noor (windows): common windows quirk: interpreter/build can lack a usable cafile and pip falls back to sdist build. quick workaround: `pip install certifi` then set `SSL_CERT_FILE` to the certifi path (cmd or powershell) — that fixes install.
Alex (sdk): plan: 1) publish official wheels for cp38-cp312-win_amd64 so pip won't build from sdist; 2) add support for REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE and fall back to certifi at runtime; 3) ship PEP 561 type stubs for AsyncClient; 4) add Windows quickstart troubleshooting and add a Windows smoke install job to CI.
ci-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/issues/512 (windows wheels + ca-fallback + typing-stubs)
